newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prison hostage crisis hits third day.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prison hostage crisis hits third day.

text.p: A group of Brazilian prisoners armed with knives continued to hold nine people hostage in a rebellion that has already lasted three days, local military police said on Tuesday.
Police surrounding the prison in Vitoria da Conquista, Bahia state, discovered the group of around 12 prisoners were digging a tunnel to try and escape.

"The prisoners were a bit angry when they found out we had discovered the tunnel but they have calmed down now. We are waiting for them to come out so we can start up negotiations again," a police official said.
The nine hostages, including two women, were seized by the prisoners during visiting hours on Saturday.

Three prison workers, who were trapped in the prison exercise ground along with 50 prisoners who did not take part in the rebellion, were rescued by being pulled over the prison walls using ropes, the police official said.
The 50 prisoners are receiving food and other necessities by the same method, he added.
The 12 rebels are demanding four cars, revolvers and around $3,800, he said.
